messages:
ryan (infra): FYI us-west1 reported persistent I/O backpressure after last maintenance window. GPU pod starts are timing out.
neha (sre): Confirmed. `k8s/attach` p95 pushed to ~1.2s and preemptible attach errs ~7% in last 8m.
liam (storage): Telemetry: a small set of NVMe devices show IOPS saturation and repeated async retries. Firmware unchanged; suspect cleaner/trim overlap with heavy small-read workloads.
sophie (oncall): Node behavior: ephemeral volumes go readonly briefly then recover, but while stalled janitor backlog grows and blocks gpu attach fsyncs.
deploy-bot: Maintenance: disk-maintenance/us-west1 completed at 3523456400.
ryan (infra): Immediate mitigations: 1) throttle janitor/trim cadence on affected racks 2) mark racks as scheduling-avoid for GPU 3) reduce background fsync rate on attach paths.
liam (storage): Running `echo 3 > /sys/module/nvme/parameters/retries` on canaries and throttling scrub cron. Early signal: attach p95 down to ~300ms.
neha (sre): Good. If retries don't drop in 20m we schedule rolling drains and move Dedicated capacity to other zones (note cost impact).
sophie (oncall): Created incident INC-2026-3523456789. Monitoring dashboards: nvme-retries, attach-latency, janitor-queue.
ryan (infra): Update: after throttles p95 ~280ms, rare readonly flaps remain. Storage team will continue triage.
